title: FEP-0001 trust_decision event (text profile, trust layer output)
description: Structural schema (FEP-0001 section 3 table, rule 8). Order rules (seq increases, one final decision per utterance, none after it) are checked by the fep-0001 conformance profile. Rule 9 (no final COMMIT with an empty text) is a SHOULD for 0.1 decisions (the SDKs report a warning) and a MUST NOT for decisions with spec_version 1.x (NTS 1.0 RC1; checked by the fep-0001 profile). Intent decisions (profile intent) use fep-0003/intent-trust-decision.schema.json.

spec_version.description: NTS 1.0 RC1 section 11.2: the version of the rules this decision follows. Absent means "0.1". A 1.x decision MUST NOT be a final COMMIT with an empty or white-space shown[0] (FEP-0001 rule 9, checked by the profile).
